concept_map.chapter_overview: Namaste! Aaj hum NCERT Class 7 Mathematics ke Chapter 11 — रेखा एवं कोण — padhenge. Pehle line segment, ray aur line ko clearly alag karenge; phir complementary (पूरक) aur supplementary (संपूरक) angles seekhenge. Uske baad intersecting lines, transversal (तिर्यक छेदी रेखा), aur jab parallel lines ko transversal kaatti hai toh corresponding aur alternate interior angles equal hote hain — yeh sab classroom examples aur numericals se samjhenge.
concept_map.welcome: Arre class, Smart Board par aaj Geometry ka maza aayega! Socho — blackboard stand, window ki jali, road crossing, railway track — har jagah lines milti hain aur angles bante hain. Teacher physically nahi hain is subject ke liye, lekin main tumhare saath bilkul school wali Hinglish mein padhaunga. Copy-pencil ready? Chalo shuru karte hain — रेखा एवं कोण!
learning_outcomes: रेखाखंड, किरण और रेखा ko identify karke unke symbols/notation se naam dena
पूरक कोण (sum 90°) aur संपूरक कोण (sum 180°) ke pairs pehchanna aur measure nikalna
प्रतिच्छेदी रेखाएँ aur तिर्यक छेदी रेखा (transversal) samajhna
Transversal se bane corresponding, alternate interior/exterior aur same-side interior angles naam dena; parallel lines par corresponding aur alternate interior angles equal apply karna

generated.say: Bacchon, pehle soft revision — tum pehle se jaante ho ki kisi aakaar mein alag-alag रेखाएँ, रेखाखंडों aur कोणों ki pehchaan kaise hoti hai. Aaj Figure 5.1 jaisi aakritiyon mein line segments aur angles dhundhne ki practice karenge. Smarn karo — ek रेखाखंड ke do अंत बिंदु hote hain. Agar un do end-points ko apni-apni directions mein endlessly badha dein, toh hamein ek रेखा prapt hoti hai. Matlab रेखा ka koi अंत बिंदु nahi hota — dono taraf infinitely chalti hai. Doosri taraf, किरण ka ek hi अंत बिंदु hota hai — usko प्रारंभिक बिंदु kehte hain; ek taraf se shuru, doosri taraf endlessly. Figure 5.2 mein clearly dikhta hai: (i) रेखाखंड, (ii) रेखा, aur (iii) किरण. Notation yaad rakho — generally रेखाखंड AB ko AB, रेखा PQ ko PQ, aur किरण OC ko OC se likhte hain. Daily life se socho: pencil tip se tip tak stick jaisa piece — रेखाखंड; seedhi road dono taraf door tak — रेखा jaisi idea; torch ki light ek bulb se ek direction — किरण. Apne doston se discuss karo — ghar, school, khet mein kahan segment dikhta hai, kahan ray. Exam tip: diagram mein do endpoints marked means segment; ek endpoint plus arrow ek taraf means ray; dono taraf arrows means line. Pehle figure carefully dekho, phir naam do. Yeh foundation clear hogi toh aage angles aur intersecting lines bilkul soft lagenge. Har geometry figure padhte waqt pehle poocho — yeh segment hai, ray hai, ya full line? Class mein role-play: ek stick dikhaye for segment, ek torch chalaye for ray, ek chalk line dono taraf extend soche for line. Jab yeh teen clear ho jayein, chapter ka baaki hissa easy lagega. Ab next concept mein hum dekhenge jab yeh lines milti hain toh angles kaise bante hain.

(ii) Ek प्रारंभिक बिंदु O + ek direction → किरण

generated.say: Ab angles ki baat! Jab do रेखाएँ ya रेखाखंड milte hain, tab कोण निर्मित होता है. Figure 5.1 aur 5.3 mein corners — konon — ko carefully dekho. Jab do lines ya segments kisi बिंदु par pratichchhed karte hain, tab yeh corners bante hain. Example: Figure 5.3 (i) mein रेखाखंड PQ aur QR, बिंदु Q par milkar कोण PQR banate hain; QR aur PR बिंदु R par कोण PRQ banate hain. Figure 5.3 (ii) mein lines AB aur CD बिंदु O par intersect karke char kon banate hain — angle AOC, COB, BOD aur DOA. Notation: कोण PQR ko angle PQR likhte hain. Tip: middle letter vertex hota hai — Q yahan vertex. Tum pehle se padh chuke ho classification — न्यून कोण (acute) 90 degree se chhota, समकोण (right) bilkul 90 degree, अधिक कोण (obtuse) 90 se bada lekin 180 se chhota. Try activity from book: apne aas-paas das aakritiyan list karo aur unme acute, obtuse, right pehchano — window corner usually right angle, open book kabhi acute kabhi obtuse. Note from book: kon ke map ke sandarbh mein bhi hum aksar angle PQR hi likhte hain; context se clear ho jaata hai. Classroom mein haath se angle banao — do fingers thodi si kholi means acute; L shape means right; zyada kholi means obtuse. Pehle figure mein kitne angles hain count karo, phir type batao. Yeh pehchaan aage complementary-supplementary ke liye zaroori hai. Jab naming karo, arms ke letters outer, vertex beech mein. Revision drill: blackboard par teen angles draw karke class se type mangwao. Galat naam mat do — समकोण bilkul 90, usse thoda kam bhi acute, thoda zyada obtuse. Har figure se pehle labels padho, phir decide karo yeh acute hai ya obtuse.

generated.say: Ab related angles — संबंधित कोण — ka pehla important pair: पूरक कोण. Rule simple hai — jab do konon ke mapon ka yog 90 degree hota hai, toh yeh kon पूरक कोण, English mein complementary angles, kehlate hain. Jab do angles complementary hote hain, toh har ek doosre ka पूरक kehlata hai. Figure 5.4 dekho — 30 degree wala angle, 60 degree wale angle ka complement hai, aur ulta bhi — because 30 + 60 = 90. Think-discuss-write se important sawaal: (1) Kya do न्यून कोण ek doosre ke complementary ho sakte hain? Haan — jaise 30 aur 60, dono acute. (2) Kya do अधिक कोण complementary ho sakte hain? Nahi — kyunki har obtuse 90 se bada, unka sum 180 se bhi zyada, 90 nahi banega. (3) Kya do समकोण complementary? Nahi — 90+90=180, jo 90 nahi. Practice: 45 ka complement = 90-45 = 45; 65 ka = 25; 41 ka = 49; 54 ka = 36. Numerical: do complementary angles ka difference 12 degree hai — find measures. Let smaller = x, larger = x+12; x+(x+12)=90 gives 2x=78 so x=39, larger=51. Figure 5.5 jaisi pairs mein check karo sum 90 hai ya nahi. Yaad rakho — complementary hone ke liye angles adjacent hona zaroori nahi; sirf measures ka sum 90 chahiye. Classroom mein: wall corner 90 ko do parts mein baanto — woh pair complementary. Exam mein formula: complement of theta = 90 minus theta. Negative answer aaye toh samajh lo angle 90 se bada tha — complementary possible nahi. Roz paanch random angles ke complements nikaalo — calculation speed badhegi aur confusion kam hogi.
generated.example: Corner of a book stand 90 degree hai; agar ek part 35 mark karo toh doosra part 55 — yeh pair complementary hai.
generated.common_mistake: Students kabhi-kabhi complementary ko 180 degree wale pair se confuse kar dete hain — 90 = complementary (पूरक), 180 = supplementary (संपूरक).
generated.memory_trick: C for Corner of square = 90° → Complementary. PUrak → Perfect Unit right angle.
generated.gesture_action: Do haathon se L (90°) banao, phir us L ko do acute pieces mein todo — complementary pair
real_life_examples: Set-square ke 30°–60°–90° triangle mein 30° aur 60° complementary
Window frame ka right angle do wooden strips se divide — unke angles sum 90°

Complementary: x + (x + 12) = 90

generated.say: Ab doosra related pair — संपूरक कोण, English mein supplementary angles. Figure 5.6 jaisi pairs dekho — har pair mein konon ke mapon ka yog 180 degree aata hai. Aise pairs संपूरक kehlate hain. Jab do angles supplementary hote hain, har ek doosre ka संपूरक kehlata hai. Formula: supplement of theta = 180 minus theta. Think-discuss: (1) Kya do अधिक कोण supplementary ho sakte hain? Nahi — do obtuse ka sum 180 se zyada hota hai. (2) Do न्यून? Dono acute ka sum 180 se kam rehta hai — so nahi. (3) Do समकोण? 90+90=180 — haan! Yeh important result hai. Practice measures: 100 ka supplement = 80; 90 ka = 90; 55 ka = 125; 125 ka = 55. Numerical: do supplementary angles mein bada, chhote se 44 degree adhik hai. Smaller x, larger x+44; x+(x+44)=180 gives 2x=136 so x=68, larger=112. Figure 5.7 mein pairs identify karo jinka sum 180. Special note: agar do आसन्न कोण संपूरक hain, toh we रैखिक युग्म (linear pair) banate hain — straight line par adjacent plus sum 180. Yeh baad mein exercise fill-ups mein aayega. Classroom: seedhi table edge ek straight angle 180 — usko do parts mein baanto, woh supplementary. Confusion door rakho: पूरक equals 90 (P for Plus to right angle), संपूरक equals 180 (S for Straight). Roz drill: random angle lo, pehle complement, phir supplement nikaalo — dono formulas alag yaad rahenge. Jab figure mein straight line dikhe, socho — adjacent angles wahan supplementary ho sakte hain. Yeh concept intersecting lines aur linear pair naming mein baar-baar use hoga.
generated.example: Straight road (180°) par ek slanted stick gira — stick ke dono taraf ke angles ka sum 180° — woh supplementary pair.
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain do acute angles bhi supplementary ho sakte hain — galat; do acute ka sum hamesha 180 se kam hota hai.
generated.memory_trick: S for Straight / संपूरक = 180°. P for Perfect right / पूरक = 90°.
generated.gesture_action: Dono arms seedhi ek line mein failao (180°), phir ek elbow se todo — do parts supplementary
real_life_examples: Open book bilkul flat table par — pages ke beech lagbhag 180°; thoda fold karo toh do supplementary parts
Seedhi wall edge par leaning stick — dono taraf ke angles sum 180°

steps: Chhota = x°, bada = (x + 44)°
Supplementary: x + x + 44 = 180

generated.concept: प्रश्नावली अभ्यास – पूरक, संपूरक और आसन्न कोण
generated.say: Ab Exercise style practice — bilkul NCERT prashnavali 5.1 jaisi soch. Pehle: har angle ka पूरक nikaalo — matlab 90 minus that angle. Phir har ka संपूरक — 180 minus. Teesra: pairs alag-alag identify karo — complementary ya supplementary. Example pairs from book: (i) 65 aur 115 → sum 180 → संपूरक; (ii) 63 aur 27 → sum 90 → पूरक; (iii) 112 aur 68 → 180 → संपूरक; (iv) 130 aur 50 → 180 → संपूरक; (v) 45 aur 45 → 90 → पूरक; (vi) 80 aur 10 → 90 → पूरक. Special finds: aisa angle jo apne पूरक ke barabar — x = 90 − x → 2x = 90 → x = 45. Aisa jo apne संपूरक ke barabar — x = 180 − x → 2x = 180 → x = 90. Figure mein angle 1 aur angle 2 supplementary hain; agar angle 1 kam hota hai toh angle 2 badhana padega taaki sum 180 rahe. Can two angles be supplementary if both acute? No. Both obtuse? No. Both right? Yes. Agar ek angle 45 se bada hai, uska complement 45 se chhota hoga — because sum fixed 90. Fill-ups: complementary sum = 90; supplementary sum = 180; agar do आसन्न कोण संपूरक hain toh we रैखिक युग्म banate hain. Naming pairs in figure: vertically opposite obtuse; adjacent complementary; equal supplementary; unequal supplementary; adjacent jo linear pair nahi banate. Yeh saare points exam mein one-two mark fill ya MCQ banate hain. Practice roz paanch pairs sum check karke — speed badhegi. Jab confusion ho, dimag se 90/180 minus karo. Teacher tip: pehle sum likho, phir label — guess se mat jao. Yeh drill chapter ke numericals ke liye muscle memory banati hai.
board_lines: पूरक युग्म: sum = 90° | संपूरक युग्म: sum = 180°
अपने पूरक के समान: 45° | अपने संपूरक के समान: 90°
generated.common_mistake: 65° aur 115° ko complementary bol dena — sum 180 hai, yeh supplementary hain, complementary nahi.
generated.memory_trick: Equal to own complement → half of 90 = 45; equal to own supplement → half of 180 = 90.
generated.gesture_action: Ek haath 45° show (self-complement); dono arms se do right angles (self-supplement pair)
real_life_examples: Door almost closed (chhota angle) vs almost open — complementary/supplementary intuition se compare
Two tiles meeting at corner making 90° vs two roads making straight 180°

generated.say: Ab section rekha-yugm. Pehla idea: प्रतिच्छेदी रेखाएँ, intersecting lines. Stand par rakha blackboard, line segments se bana letter X, window ka jali-darwaza — in sab mein common kya? Yeh intersecting lines ke examples hain (Figure 5.8). Definition: do rekhaen l aur m pratichchhed karti hain agar unme ek बिंदु ubhaynisthth ho. Woh common point unka pratichchhed bindu kehlata hai. Important soch: kya do lines ya segments zaruri intersect karein? Nahi — kabhi parallel, kabhi alag alag. Kya figure mein aise segment pairs mil sakte hain jo intersect nahi karte? Haan. Aur deep sawaal — kya do distinct lines ek se zyada binduon par intersect kar sakti hain? Agar do points common hon toh woh same line ban jaati hain; do alag lines at most ek point par milti hain. Try: aas-paas examples jahan lines sam kon (90) par intersect karti hain — window frame, notebook edges, plus sign. Equilateral triangle ke vertices par intersecting lines se bane angles 60 degree hote hain. Rectangle banao — charon shirshon par angles 90. Last: agar do lines intersect karti hain, kya hamesha right angles par? Nahi — kabhi acute-obtuse pairs, kabhi right. Figure thinking: AB aur DE, C par intersect; AB aur DB, B par; AB aur EB, B par — aur dusre ten pairs dhundho. Classroom activity: do pencils cross karo — intersection point ungli se pakdo. Exam mein intersecting ka matlab sirf cut nahi — precisely common point hona. Jab diagram mein cross dikhe, pehle intersection point label karo, phir angles count karo. Yeh foundation transversal ke liye bhi kaam aayegi. Yaad rakho: intersecting hona aur perpendicular hona alag baatein hain.
